svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a block 36 wide, 34 tall, 12.5 deep. Square all faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tooth (lower 24 mm): full depth. Its top face is the latching face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: keep it flat and square to the back. File a 4 x 45 degree lead-in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shoulder (top 10 mm): mill or file away the outer 7.5 mm, leaving

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 deep, then file its top back edge to a 5 x 45 degree ramp.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 6 mm spring holes 8 deep in the inside face, 10 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of centre, 12 up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the tooth passes through the back wall and stands 6 proud;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shoulder rests on the inside of the wall (the out stop).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It hooks 4 mm under the dock catch; pressing the thumb button

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pulls it in 5 mm, 1 mm clear of the catch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it slides in its slot without binding at any point.
